description: For game developers: submit a browser game to be listed on Hocus Games. Games made with AI are welcome and reviewed like any other. Requires: an https link where the game plays (no download), title, a plain description, developer name, the developer's own contact email, honest answers about ads and purchases, a square icon (icon_url; 512x512 recommended, 256x256 minimum) and 3-8 screenshots of actual gameplay (screenshot_urls; not title screens or logos), images as https links to PNG, JPEG or WebP files, and confirm_rights:true only if the person said they made the game or may submit it. Optional facts (genres, devices, inputs, player modes, orientation, sign-up) are shown as "declared by the developer". We email the contact a confirmation link (48 hours); a person reviews the game only after that, and emails the decision. Every problem is returned at once, so fix them all and submit again. Returns the submission id and a status_token for get_submission_status.

ai_tools.description: Optional: which AI tools or models helped.

confirm_rights.description: The submitter made this game or is allowed to submit it, and the screenshots show actual gameplay. Only true if the person said so.

contact_email.description: The developer's own email for this submission: we send the confirmation link and our decision there. Never shown publicly.

description.description: What the game is and how it plays, in 1-4 plain sentences (30-600 characters). No marketing superlatives.

developer_name.description: Developer or studio name, shown on the listing.

devices.description: Devices the game is made to work on.

game_url.description: The page where the game plays in a browser, https://. No download, no app store.

has_purchases.description: Does the game sell anything (in-game purchases, paid unlocks)?

icon_url.description: https link to a square PNG/JPEG/WebP icon, 512x512 recommended, at least 256x256.

made_with_ai.description: Optional: was the game made with AI tools? Never counts against a game.

notes.description: Optional note for the reviewer (controls, what to try first).

screenshot_urls.description: 3-8 https links to screenshots of actual gameplay, each at least 640x360.

signup_required.description: Must players create an account to play?

name: submit_game
title: Submit a game to Hocus Games
